experiment: P3o-U deployable local time-frequency phase-dynamics conditional ISRJ calibration
decision: Do not generate the reserved confirmation identities, do not retune thresholds/features/residuals, and do not use P3o-U as a deployable ISRJ route.
hypothesis_result: not supported: fixed local phase dynamics did not add the preregistered source-FPR reduction beyond the posterior-only capacity control and the time-bin-shuffled control.
failure_mechanism: U2 can reduce some source false positives versus U0, but it does so with an approximately three-point ISRJ recall loss and cannot exceed the posterior-only or shuffled-phase capacity controls. Thus the evidence is consistent with a response/suppression trade-off, not a phase-specific separability mechanism. The no-harm gates also fail for recall and worst-combination protection.

data_disposition.all_consumed_roles: frozen_for_P3oU; no retuning or re-analysis for selection

next_allowed_action: Do not deepen or broaden local phase dynamics. Any future ISRJ proposal must start from a new preregistered observable with an oracle-sufficiency check and an equal-capacity shuffled/control comparison on wholly new identities.
